name: The mage’s assistance

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest chain; exact in-world date unknown

summary: Tervosh confirms Jaina’s support and points west to Hendel.
description: At Sentry Point, Archmage Tervosh says Jaina knows of the inquiry and has directed him to assist. Hendel is west of the tower, keeping watch over Theramore’s scouts as they return from searching for Brackenwall. This is an account of the quest’s lead, not a claim that every named figure shares the illustrated frame. The marsh has yielded the soldier’s position; the confrontation itself remains ahead.
